test_DataPackage_init: test the DataPackage class initializes with empty prompts, answers, and field names
test_DataPackage_verify_lengths: test the DataPackage.verify_lengths method returns true when all lists are equal length
test_DataPackage_load_from_filepath: test the DataPackage.load_from_filepath method loads prompts and answers from a JSONL file
test_DataPackage_load_and_prepare: test the DataPackage.load_and_prepare method loads data from results JSON, longfact directory, or custom task
test_DataPackage_shuffle_data: test the DataPackage.shuffle_data method produces reproducible shuffles with a given random seed
